process_area.title: Transaction Due Diligence, Valuation & Deal Structuring

value_stream.name: Corporate Development, Mergers & Acquisitions, Divestiture & Strategic Transactions

fields.Participants: Corp Dev, Strategy (links to VS-33.3), Insights (links to VS-44), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Trade/B2B Sales (links to VS-11), Marketing (links to VS-14), affected business unit, external commercial advisors

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "compile findings into the commercial DD report, flag value-killers/risk, and…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-621 (ensure controlled execution — Transaction Due Diligence, Valuation & Deal Structuring (PA-130.2).)
- operational: bottom-up hypotheses; operational: store-level overlap analysis
Pain Points / Risks: - **Synergy-overstatement risk**: Commercial DD overstating synergies; mitigated by bottom-up hypotheses
- **Missed-cannibalization risk**: Network overlap understated; mitigated by store-level overlap analysis
System Touchpoints: - Strategy/insights (links to VS-33.3/VS-44); merchandising (links to VS-01); competitive intel (links to VS-57); analytics (links to VS-28)

steps.activity: Corp Dev/Strategy conduct commercial DD: market size/growth, competitive position, customer base and concentration (trade/B2B/B2G mix), store portfolio performance, assortment/channel/digital maturity, brand equity, and revenue quality (links to VS-44/VS-57 for market intelligence)

Corp Dev/Merchandising assess strategic fit and synergy potential: category/assortment overlap and gaps, store/network overlap and cannibalization, channel complementarity, vendor overlap, and revenue/cost synergy hypotheses to refine the model (links to W3981)
Corp Dev compile findings into the commercial DD report, flag value-killers/risk, and update the deal model and SPA price/terms (links to W3991)

fields.Participants: Finance (links to VS-17.4), Treasury (links to VS-18), Tax (links to VS-79), Corp Dev, external financial/tax DD advisors, Legal

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "Finance/external-advisors conduct financial DD" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-post of "Finance/Tax update the deal model, adjust the price/working-capital mechanism" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-621 (ensure controlled execution — Transaction Due Diligence, Valuation & Deal Structuring (PA-130.2).)
- operational: quality-of-earnings DD; operational: tax DD and SPA indemnities
Pain Points / Risks: - **Earnings-quality risk**: Overpaying for non-recurring earnings; mitigated by quality-of-earnings DD
- **Hidden-tax-liability risk**: Undisclosed assessments; mitigated by tax DD and SPA indemnities
System Touchpoints: - Finance (links to VS-17.4); tax (links to VS-79); treasury (links to VS-18); intercompany/TP (links to VS-72); analytics (links to VS-28)

steps.activity: Finance/external-advisors conduct financial DD: quality of earnings (normalized EBITDA, one-offs, related-party), working capital (level and seasonality), net debt, off-balance-sheet items, cash conversion, capex/maintenance, and historical/forecast performance — consistent with BuildRight's PFRS reporting (links to VS-17.4)

Tax/external-advisors conduct tax DD: direct/indirect tax exposure (VAT, income tax, withholding, local business tax, real property tax links to VS-79), transfer pricing (links to VS-72), tax incentives (BOI/PEZA), historical filings/assessments, and structuring implications

Finance/Tax update the deal model, adjust the price/working-capital mechanism (links to W3982), and flag financial/tax risks for SPA protection (links to W3991) and post-close integration (links to PA-130.3)

fields.Participants: Legal (links to VS-100), Compliance (links to VS-22/VS-119), Tax (links to VS-79), Litigation (links to VS-100.2), external legal counsel, Corp Dev

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records, material contracts" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag of "flag risks for SPA protection" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-621 (ensure controlled execution — Transaction Due Diligence, Valuation & Deal Structuring (PA-130.2).)
- operational: real-estate DD; operational: DD and consents
Pain Points / Risks: - **Title/encumbrance risk**: Store/DC sites not owned/leased cleanly; mitigated by real-estate DD
- **Change-of-control risk**: Material contracts/permits terminating on change of control; mitigated by DD and consents
System Touchpoints: - Legal (links to VS-100); compliance (links to VS-22/VS-119/VS-91/VS-86); tax (links to VS-79); litigation (links to VS-100.2); competition (links to VS-129)

steps.activity: Legal/external-counsel conduct corporate and legal DD: corporate structure and authority, ownership/shareholder records, material contracts (customers, vendors, leases links to VS-42, licenses/permits links to VS-22/VS-76), real estate title and encumbrances, IP (links to VS-100), and litigation/matters (links to VS-100.2)

Legal/Compliance conduct regulatory and compliance DD: licenses/permits across all locations (links to VS-22/VS-76), BIR/tax compliance, LGU/local-business-tax, data privacy (links to VS-91), competition (links to VS-129), ABC/AML (links to VS-86), labor (links to VS-84), product compliance (links to VS-117/VS-114), and any consent/change-of-control requirements
Legal flag risks for SPA protection (reps/warranties, indemnities, specific indemnity, escrow/retention, walk-right) (links to W3991) and regulatory-clearance planning (links to W3992)

fields.Participants: Supply Chain (links to VS-02/VS-04/VS-06), Store Ops (links to VS-07), IT (links to VS-27/VS-113), affected business unit, Integration Lead, Corp Dev

workflows.name: Operational, IT, Systems & Integration Due Diligence

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "footprint and capacity, supply chain and vendor base, inventory and shrink,…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "IT/Integration-Lead conduct IT and systems DD" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-compile of "compile findings and update the integration plan, Day-1 plan" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-621 (ensure controlled execution — Transaction Due Diligence, Valuation & Deal Structuring (PA-130.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Integration-complexity risk**: Disparate IT/ERP inflating integration cost/time; mitigated by IT DD
- **Operational risk**: DC/store issues hidden; mitigated by operational DD
System Touchpoints: - Supply chain (links to VS-02/VS-04/VS-06); store ops (links to VS-07); IT/EA (links to VS-27/VS-113); MDM (links to VS-29); ITAM (links to VS-99)

steps.activity: Supply Chain/Store-Ops conduct operational DD: store network and performance, DC/warehouse footprint and capacity, supply chain and vendor base, inventory and shrink, operating model and staffing, and operational synergy/cost opportunities and risks
steps.r: Supply Chain / Store Ops / Corp Dev

steps.activity: IT/Integration-Lead conduct IT and systems DD: ERP and application landscape (alignment to BuildRight's unified cloud ERP and enterprise architecture links to VS-113), data quality/master data (links to VS-29), infrastructure, security (links to VS-27), integration complexity/cost, and the carve-out/separation picture (links to VS-99 ITAM)
Integration Lead compile findings and update the integration plan, Day-1 plan (links to W3994), and synergy/cost cases (links to W3993)

fields.Participants: HR (links to VS-19/VS-102/VS-103), Labor Relations (links to VS-84), Legal, Finance (links to VS-17.4 benefits), Corp Dev

workflows.name: HR, People & Culture Due Diligence (incl. Labor/Union)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "headcount, key talent and retention risk, compensation/benefits and comparability" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-collect of "collective bargaining agreements, union representation and pending labor cases" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "update the model" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-621 (ensure controlled execution — Transaction Due Diligence, Valuation & Deal Structuring (PA-130.2).)
- operational: retention design; operational: labor DD and SPA protection
Pain Points / Risks: - **Key-talent-loss risk**: Critical people leaving post-close; mitigated by retention design
- **Labor-dispute risk**: Acquired labor cases/union disruption; mitigated by labor DD and SPA protection
System Touchpoints: - HR/payroll (links to VS-19/VS-102/VS-103); labor relations (links to VS-84); legal (links to VS-100); finance (links to VS-17.4)

steps.activity: HR conduct people DD: org structure and headcount, key talent and retention risk, compensation/benefits and comparability (links to VS-102), payroll/statutory compliance (links to VS-19.2), contingent workforce (links to VS-98), and culture/engagement indicators

Labor-Relations/Legal assess labor and union risk: collective bargaining agreements, union representation and pending labor cases (links to VS-84/NLRC), DOLE compliance, retrenchment/restructuring exposure, and any Philippine labor-law transfer/absorption considerations for acquired employees
HR quantify people-cost and integration implications (retention, harmonization, severance), update the model (links to W3981), and design the retention and Day-1 people plan (links to W3994/W3996)

fields.Participants: ESG/Sustainability (links to VS-25), HSE (links to VS-24), Compliance (links to VS-22/VS-119/VS-86), Human Rights/Responsible Sourcing (links to VS-131), Legal (links to VS-100), external ESG advisors

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "record and incidents" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-update of "update the model and SPA" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: environmental DD; operational: ABC/sanctions DD
Pain Points / Risks: - **Legacy-environmental risk**: Undisclosed contamination/permit gaps; mitigated by environmental DD
- **Ethics/sanctions risk**: Acquired misconduct/sanctions exposure; mitigated by ABC/sanctions DD
System Touchpoints: - ESG (links to VS-25); HSE (links to VS-24); compliance (links to VS-22/VS-86/VS-119); energy (links to VS-120/VS-108); human rights (links to VS-131)

steps.activity: Sustainability/HSE conduct ESG and environmental DD: environmental compliance and permits (DENR/EMB links to VS-25.1/VS-114), HSE record and incidents (links to VS-24), energy/carbon (links to VS-120/VS-108), waste/circular (links to VS-73), and sustainability reporting maturity

Compliance conduct ethics/ABC/AML and human-rights DD: ABC/AML exposure (links to VS-86), ethics/speak-up matters (links to VS-119), sanctions, product compliance/recall history (links to VS-89/VS-117), and supply-chain human-rights/responsible-sourcing practices (links to VS-131)
Sustainability/Legal flag ESG/compliance risks, update the model and SPA (links to W3991), and feed integration requirements (links to PA-130.3) and BuildRight's ESG reporting (links to VS-25.3)

fields.Owner: VP Legal & Compliance / Head of Corporate Development
fields.Participants: Legal (links to VS-100), external counsel, Corp Dev, Finance/Tax, HR, CEO, sellers/sellers' counsel
fields.Trigger: Completion of DD; binding gate (links to W3983)

Automation Opportunity: - workflow automation; system-driven processing with exception handling
Controls: - CTL-621 (ensure controlled execution — Transaction Due Diligence, Valuation & Deal Structuring (PA-130.2).)
- operational: specific indemnities and W&I; operational: walk-away discipline and stage-gate
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inadequate-protection risk**: DD risks not reflected in SPA; mitigated by specific indemnities and W&I
- **Negotiation-creep risk**: Price/terms eroding returns; mitigated by walk-away discipline and stage-gate
System Touchpoints: - Legal (links to VS-100); records (links to VS-88); insurance (links to VS-26); competition (links to VS-129 W3992); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Legal/external-counsel draft the SPA (asset or share purchase agreement) reflecting structure (links to W3982): purchase price and mechanism, working-capital adjustment, escrow/retention/earn-out, reps & warranties, indemnities and caps/baskets, specific indemnities for DD findings, conditions precedent (incl. PCC clearance links to W3992), termination rights, and restrictive covenants
Corp Dev/Legal/CEO negotiate the SPA with the sellers, manage open issues and price/terms movement, and secure insurance (W&I) where appropriate (links to VS-26)
Legal obtain final approvals (links to W3983), manage signing, conditions-satisfaction, and pre-close obligations, and transition to Day-1/closing (links to W3994)

fields.Participants: Legal (links to VS-100/VS-129), external competition counsel, Corp Dev, Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), affected business unit, SEC/corporate secretariat (links to VS-36.1)

workflows.name: Regulatory Clearance, PCC Merger Notification & Antitrust Approval

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "footprint/customers trigger review" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document all clearances in the deal file" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: early filing and remedies planning; operational: staging and clean-team
Pain Points / Risks: - **Clearance-block risk**: PCC/sector clearance conditions blocking or delaying close; mitigated by early filing and remedies planning
- **Gun-jumping risk**: Pre-close coordination breaches standstill; mitigated by staging and clean-team
System Touchpoints: - Competition (links to VS-129); legal/corporate secretarial (links to VS-100/VS-36.1); tax (links to VS-79); LGU (links to VS-76); customs (links to VS-87); privacy (links to VS-91); labor (links to VS-84)

steps.activity: Legal/Competition-counsel confirm notifiability and file the PCC merger notification (links to VS-129 W3967) and any foreign notifications where BuildRight's footprint/customers trigger review; manage conditions/remedies if Phase 2

Legal/Corp-Sec manage SEC and corporate-regulatory filings (links to VS-36.1), LGU/license transfers (links to VS-22/VS-76), BIR/tax-clearance (links to VS-79), and any sector-specific approvals (customs links to VS-87, data-privacy consent links to VS-91, labor links to VS-84)
Legal track conditions-satisfaction to closing (links to W3994), manage gun-jumping risk, and document all clearances in the deal file (links to VS-88)
